core_obligations: Reduce to an acyclic extended complex: put O_U (the image presheaf of the sum of the extension-by-zero sheaves, as in the statement) in degree -1 and show that taking sections of the resulting extended complex K^{ext}_bullet over any open W gives a complex homotopy equivalent to zero (proof lines 1219-1227).

Split according to the open W: write I = I_1 disjoint union I_2 with i in I_1 exactly when W is contained in U_i; if I_1 is empty the section complex vanishes, and otherwise O_U(W) = O_X(W) and the degree p term is the direct sum of copies of O_X(W) indexed by (p+1)-tuples from I_1, with the differential written out explicitly as a finite sum (proof lines 1228-1252).

Exhibit the contracting homotopy: fix i_fix in I_1 and define h by inserting i_fix in the first position and shifting, with h(s)_{i_0...} = 0 unless i_0 = i_fix, then verify (dh + hd)(s) = s by the displayed computation in which the inserted terms cancel, proving acyclicity and hence the claimed homology presheaves (proof lines 1253-1283).
proof_roadmap: Extend the complex by placing the image presheaf in degree -1 and reduce the claim to the contractibility of the extended complex of sections over each open W (proof lines 1219-1227).
Split the index set into those U_i containing W and the rest, and compute the terms and the differential of the resulting complex of sections (proof lines 1228-1252).
Write down the homotopy inserting a fixed index and verify the cancellation along the displayed eqnarray computation (proof lines 1253-1283).
difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the homology presheaves of the extension-by-zero Cech complex K(U)_bullet of a covering of a ringed space: they vanish in degrees other than zero and are the image presheaf O_U of the augmentation in degree zero (statement lines 1200-1215). The proof extends the complex by that image presheaf in degree -1 and then works section-wise over an arbitrary open W, splitting the index set according to which U_i contain W, which turns the section complex into a direct sum of copies of O_X(W) with an explicit differential (proof lines 1226-1252). The contractibility is then shown by the explicit homotopy that inserts a fixed index i_fix and cancels against the differential in a displayed computation (proof lines 1253-1283). The two ingredients that have to be supplied by hand are the case split on W and the homotopy itself; nothing is cited beyond the construction of the complex. The claim is H2.
